WITH dimapur AS (
    SELECT id, geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE id = '86c99449-dfa2-40ee-9256-88c8311ced3e'  -- Dimapur
),
neighbours AS (
    SELECT d.id, d.names."primary" AS name, d.geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d
    JOIN dimapur d0
      ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, d0.geometry)   -- adjacent counties
    WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
),
smallest AS (
    SELECT id, name, geometry,
           ST_Area(geometry) AS area
    FROM neighbours
    ORDER BY area ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT id,
       name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM smallest;
```

WITH target AS (
    SELECT id, geometry
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
    WHERE subtype = 'county'
      AND region = 'IN-NL'
      AND names."primary" = 'Peren'
),
adjacent AS (
    SELECT d.id,
           d.names."primary" AS name,
           d.geometry,
           ST_Area(d.geometry) AS area
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') d
    JOIN target t
      ON ST_Touches(d.geometry, t.geometry)   -- districts that share a border with Peren
    WHERE d.subtype = 'county'
      AND d.region = 'IN-NL'
      AND d.id <> t.id
)
SELECT id,
       name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM adjacent
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

WITH target AS (

candidates AS (

        id,
        names."primary" AS name,
        geometry,
        ST_Distance(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM target)) AS dist_m,
        ST_Area(geometry) AS area
    FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')

      AND ST_DWithin(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM target), 100000)  -- 100 km
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM candidates
ORDER BY area DESC
